name: The Stand-In
pitch: You are only well while someone else is sick: wait until every curse you own is home, retch them all into the enemy in one hit, and for three pulses their arts land on themselves.
channel: art, with curses as the engine

new.name: Moved Sickness
new.effect: Curses from your own life have no duration on you. An art with the cleanse tag sends them to the target; when one ends, is cleansed or is pushed out it comes home. You can never clear them yourself.

new.name: Turned Hand
new.effect: A curse: a bearer's hit art still pays and lands on its owner at half strength, through their own ward, at most 25 % of their maximum health. The basic attack is not touched.
new.second_home: any curse build, any mirror for the strong

new.name: Virulence
new.effect: +40 points to arts per curse on you, or per curse an art held as it fired.
new.second_home: any curse build, cursed on purpose

new.name: Relapse
new.effect: Each affliction that comes home refunds 2 % of maximum linh lực.
new.second_home: any curse that returns or is recast

new.name: Purge
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 2.2, cost 0.12 with Rush Order, 2 s, guard holding all your afflictions. Moves every curse and status on you, then hits.

new.name: Bile
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 2.2, cost 0.08, 3 s, guard no curse on you.

new.name: Phlegm
new.effect: Body hit, c_art 1.85, cost 0.05, 2 s, guard no curse on you.

new.name: Sickness-Moving Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Wood and Fire. Carries Moved Sickness, Purge, Bile, Phlegm, seals Hundred Ills.

new.name: Hundred Ills
new.effect: Curses and bad states, Wood, outer, sealed by a technique, size 9. Notable Virulence.

new.name: The Gilded Spittoon
new.effect: A hồ lô, named. L3 and Relapse.

new.name: Chronic affliction
new.effect: A curse owned by a character, compiled from a real state, with no duration on its owner. Combat rule 8, Formulas F, Character Stats.

questions: Formulas F's tag block names arts carrying the tag, and rule 6 makes hit, body and qi tags. Is one curse on hit meant to silence every hit art for 3 pulses? That is in the rules today.
Rule 13 says the basic attack always runs, and its tags include hit. This sheet reads that as immune. Is it?
